2D Convolution Stride and Step Flexibility
nodes.rationale: Allows stride and step parameterization on input and output image2d_t structs to support arbitrary ROI spatial filtering.

nodes.label: AE32 Vector Optimization for Cross-Correlation
nodes.rationale: Leverages Xtensa dual multiply-accumulate (MAC) assembly loop unrolling to compute cross-correlation inner products in constant cycles.

nodes.label: Xtensa AE32 Multiply-Accumulate Convolution Acceleration
nodes.rationale: Achieves single-cycle MAC instructions on Xtensa LX6/LX7 DSP extensions by packing 32-bit floating point coefficients into vector registers.

nodes.label: FFT-Based Radix-2 DCT Computation Rationale
nodes.rationale: Formulates Discrete Cosine Transform via radix-2 Fast Fourier Transform kernel to achieve O(N log N) computational complexity on embedded DSPs.

nodes.label: ESP-DSP Discrete Cosine Transform Module Index
Spatial Matrix Dot Product Acceleration Rationale
nodes.rationale: Accelerates 2D image matrix dot products via aligned row-stride memory fetches and SIMD MAC unrolling for computer vision on ESP32.

nodes.label: SIMD Hardware Acceleration for Dot Products
nodes.rationale: Dot product primitives utilize Xtensa AE32 and ESP32-S3 AES3 SIMD vector instructions to achieve high-throughput multiply-accumulate performance for signal filtering.

nodes.label: Precomputed Bit-Reversal Tables for Radix-2 FFT
nodes.rationale: Decimation-in-time radix-2 FFT requires bit-reversed indexing; storing lookup tables eliminates runtime bit permutation overhead.

nodes.label: Radix-4 Real Transform Arithmetic Minimization
nodes.rationale: Radix-4 FFT computes real sequences by packing two real inputs into one complex butterfly stage, halving execution cycles relative to radix-2.

nodes.label: Circular Delay Line State Buffering for FIR
nodes.rationale: Using a wrapped circular delay line avoids costly memory copies of previous sample states in high-frequency sensor filtering loops.

nodes.label: Direct Form II Biquad IIR Filter
Cascaded Second-Order Sections (SOS) Stability
nodes.rationale: Decomposing high-order IIR filters into cascaded second-order Direct Form II biquads minimizes sensitivity to coefficient quantization and pole drift.

nodes.label: EKF State Prediction and Covariance Correction Flow
nodes.rationale: Separates state transition Jacobian linearization from observation updates, balancing process noise Q and measurement noise covariance R.

nodes.label: 13-State Vector Formulation for Attitude & Sensor Drift Fusion
nodes.rationale: Incorporates 4D attitude quaternion, 3D gyro bias, 3D magnetic amplitude, and 3D magnetometer deviation into a single state vector to eliminate sensor bias drifts.
